parameters.prompt: A cute small robot actor, polished and professionally built, an android trying very hard to pass as a human. Its round ball head and its mitten hands are a smooth pale gold-white, like pale android skin. Its head has a big dark round screen face, two small round cream ear pods, and a short gold collar joining the head to the body, and on the screen glowing yellow-gold eyes and a polite, slightly too-wide stiff smile. On top of its dome is short cropped dark brown clay hair in small tight curls brushed forward. Over the screen it wears classic thick black wayfarer-style glasses with slightly trapezoid lenses and a tiny round camera lens in the outer corner of each frame. Its body is a tall upright rounded-rectangle box in royal blue like a plain blue t-shirt with a crew neckline, perfectly symmetrical, and it stands stiffly at attention with its arms straight down. Polished, cinematic claymation short film look: smooth saturated matte modeling clay with subtle thumbprints, chunky rounded toy-like forms, soft warm theater lighting with a gentle rim light, shallow depth of field. Standing on a warm wooden theater stage in front of a softly blurred deep red velvet curtain, lit by a soft spotlight. Full body, three-quarter front view, centered and in frame. A single character, no text, no letters, no logos, no brand marks, no badges.
